title: The Skeleton Lake of the Himalayas

lines.text: High in the Himalayas lies a frozen lake called Roopkund.
Around its shores lie hundreds of human skeletons.
A forest ranger stumbled upon them in 1942.
For decades, people believed they all died in a single storm.
But in 2019, scientists finally tested their DNA.
The bones came from different groups, who died centuries apart.
Some even had ancestry from the distant Mediterranean.
Why they all ended up at this lake is still unsolved.
